key_insight: vdW confinement in confined epitaxy does more than steer nucleation: it creates strong interfacial mechanical forces that can reshape monolayer NbSe2 growth on the atomic scale.
engineering_relevance: Designing and tuning interfacial mechanics could become a practical lever for faster, higher-quality 2D material synthesis in scalable growth platforms.
method: AI-assisted DFT calculations of monolayer NbSe2 confined between c-plane sapphire and h-BN
Force-electronic landscape analysis to quantify atomic forces on Nb and Se
Interfacial interaction energy estimation under vdW confinement
evidence_signal: The abstract reports large calculated forces of +0.070 eV/Å on Nb and -0.04 eV/Å on Se, with unit-cell interfacial interaction energy up to 2.4 eV.
watch_item: The conclusion is based on computational modeling, so experimental validation is still needed to confirm how strongly these interfacial forces govern real growth outcomes.
paper_title: Resolving the interfacial mechanical landscape of monolayer NbSe2 grown by confined epitaxy
